title: Fallen man freed only by free divine pardon
source_text: I. Homo semel per peccatum factus mortis aeternae reus non potuit a poena peccato debita liberari, & jus ad vitam aeternam habere, nisi per summam clementiam Dei peccata illi condonantis, eumque ad vitam aeternam gratuito acceptantis.
pass_a_gloss: Once made liable to eternal death by sin, man could not be freed from the penalty due to sin, nor have a right to eternal life, except through the supreme clemency of God pardoning his sins and freely accepting him to eternal life.
pass_b_english: Once guilty of eternal death, man cannot escape sin’s due penalty or gain eternal life except by God’s free pardon and acceptance.
